I also know there's a lot of reclaimed pellets in the materials cage that hasn't been authorized for this product yet. Before I make any authorization decision, I need quality and environmental-compliance sign-off per plant policy. So let's hear from those teams first. Who's here from Quality and Environmental?

transcript.text: My completed lab review shows the reclaimed polymer is suitable for this housing only at a 15% reclaimed-to-85% virgin blend. I also confirmed that the first 50 molded housings must receive FTIR identity testing, but the lab result has not yet been attached to the production traveler.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share my environmental-compliance findings. My review of the supplier's revised safety data sheet — received late yesterday and not yet entered in the plant's chemical register — classifies the reclaimed lot's additive residue as regulated process waste. This means any use of this material requires labeled segregated storage and a hazardous-waste manifest for any discarded pellets or purge material. This classification directly affects how we must handle, store, and document this lot before and during the run, and it needs to be reflected in our waste and documentation controls before Mara makes any authorization decision.
